page: Microsoft Azure L8as_v5 is a virtual machine instance from the Lasv5 server family, built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an AMD processor. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 8 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

A defining characteristic of the L8as_v5 instance is its integrated local storage configuration. It includes 1920 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, designed for low-latency data access. Additionally, the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the combination of dedicated AMD processing cores, a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, and a substantial local NVMe SSD allocation provides a balanced hardware profile for data-intensive operations. The instance is engineered for workloads requiring fast local scratch space and significant memory capacity, such as relational databases, NoSQL transactional systems, and local data analytics pipelines.
